correctness.rationale: Centered hypersimplex coordinate facet distances give exact covering radius and all minimizing normal directions for every rank, including endpoints and median. In tangent charts only subsets active at each facet remain competitive, giving a positive-spanning top-s-subset support function. The local event rescales to a bounded polar Q and contributes r^(N-2)*Vol(Q)*epsilon^(N-2); its chamber triangulation has exact Jacobian 1/sqrt(m), yielding the factorial constant. All charts are disjoint at small epsilon and Jacobian corrections are O(epsilon^2), giving rigorous absolute error O(epsilon^(N-1)). The independent standalone checker passed 154 structural tests for N=3..7 and tangent m=3..6.
